journey.name: custom fee replaces preset in settings
journey.description: Verifies that the default custom fee screen in Settings shows the saved rate as selected, so the first number pad key replaces it instead of appending to it, and Remove clears it. Preconditions: an onboarded wallet; no funds needed.

actions.action: Open Settings, tap Transaction Speed (id "TransactionSpeedSettings"), tap Custom (id "custom"), enter 20 with the number pad (ids "N2", "N0") and tap Continue
Tap Custom (id "custom") again and verify the amount reads 20 with a highlighted background
Tap 5 (id "N5") and verify the amount reads 5, not 205, with no highlight
Tap 0 (id "N0") and verify the amount reads 50
Go back without saving, tap Custom (id "custom") again, tap Remove (id "NRemove") and verify the amount reads 0
